type: Focused additive scientific-value reassessment requested by integrating lead; no new outcomes, statistics, sources or full-paper review. Prior original decisions preserved.

benchmark.inspection: Whole actual submitted CSPG4-only letter read; submission is not acceptance or an absolute empirical standard.
benchmark.relevant_standard: Exploratory RNA histotype comparison, source/donor sensitivity and assay-separated corroboration can warrant tissue-protein assessment, while acknowledging bulk mixture, no accessible protein and unknown historical overlap. A favorable therapeutic direction, stronger A, universal protein validation or a wider reference is not required of every independent descriptive question.

decision: YES: continue development of the retained narrow GPNMB EMC-versus-LGFMS tissue-RNA observation as a concise exploratory comparative phenotype publication candidate. This is a scientific-value recommendation, not publication authorization or a completed manuscript/clearance.
what_changed: The actual checked source ledgers do not currently identify an additional authenticated accessible per-case GPNMB matrix ready but unevaluated. Earlier generic HOLD wording conflated unavailable/crosswalk/identity gaps and missing cell/protein data with such a ready-matrix blocker. The actual submitted benchmark and precise source-state distinction support a narrower useful RNA-only contribution. No new favorable outcome was selected.
new_useful_knowledge: Within these authentic public specimens, GPNMB tissue-RNA abundance tends to be lower in EMC than in diagnostically relevant LGFMS, with valid high EMC exceptions. Directionally concordant RNA-seq and array comparisons make this a useful source-qualified histotype phenotype, not just generic RNA plus a drug name. It supplies LGFMS and ordinary/high EMC as concrete contrasting localization specimens, rather than suggesting uniformly low EMC or importing expression expectations across myxoid histologies.
supported_scope: Existing fixed primary EMC-LGFMS contrast only: all13 Hofvander EMC and13 LGFMS, all6 array EMC and17 LGFMS, assay-specific units and source qualifications; primary12/old9 and available-year sensitivities retained. Unknown cross-cohort donor dependence prevents fully independent replication; no cells/protein/clinical effect is measured.
contrary_evidence_required: Valid LR5081-14 high RNA and other high primary cases remain; primary12/old9 have a stronger contrast than all13. Do not drop the recurrence or infer recurrence causality.
Partial same-year subsets weaken certainty and are not full batch adjustment.
Secondary EMC-MLPS comparison is not reproduced in allfour 3SEQ conditions; this defeats a pan-myxoid or uniform-low interpretation, not the fixed LGFMS contrast.
All10 GSE4303 conditions, literal missing/null probes, allfour 3SEQ peaks/composites and all12 processed TempO contexts remain separate scales; no pooled TPM or unavailable-to-zero conversion.
Post-exposure selection from prior antigen/gene work and known values is explicit. No old one-sided p inversion, new significance, target reranking or cold preregistration claim.
strongest_alternative: Different stromal/immune/differentiation mixtures, handling/capture/year/grade/treatment and unknown donor overlap may contribute to the tissue-RNA contrast. Those alternatives limit cellular/causal interpretation but do not erase the directly measured bulk phenotype; the paper must not turn it into malignant-cell abundance, accessible protein or an ADC failure/benefit claim.
prior_art: Hofvander global transcriptomic profiling and public gene data are published prior art; Brenca source-specific within-EMC comparisons are prior art. The exact permitted primary GPNMB EMC-LGFMS contrast check has been completed, not still pending. It did not authenticate an already published identical measured contrast in inspected fields; no first-ever claim or absolute literature-absence proof is required. Unavailable broader GPNMB pathology/source bodies remain explicit uncertainty and must not be described as measured negatives.

concrete_followthrough: Prepare one concise exploratory report using the frozen numerical outputs and existing exact source/coverage records, with a single primary LGFMS question and explicit adverse conditions. Integrating lead decides publication authority/checks separately. Do not expand gene panels, chase significance, add source-presence as a finding or wait for universal protein proof. Genuine additional source-linked RNA evidence, if found, is evaluated before promotion; current unresolved sources stay named rather than fabricated exclusions.
potential_value_defeat: If an authenticated primary already reports the identical source-qualified contrast and the reanalysis adds no useful robustness/exception/experimental-sampling information, or suitable newly linked native evidence reverses the meaningful LGFMS pattern, reassess the concise contribution. Do not salvage a paper from generic target presence or a failed invented-enrichment speculation.
